scope: Human visual inspection of explicitly listed original frames; not exhaustive temporal acceptance

products.observations: Below-bridge camera exposes tool housing, cable and socket row; seating composition readable. Latch is too small for this rear view alone to prove latch mechanics.
products.decision: Useful rear replacement candidate; full-cycle temporal review still required.

products.observations: Pressing tongue/yellow tip, withdrawn housing and raised latch are distinguishable across the three frames. Blue actuator occupies much of the upper left but does not fully hide the latch contact area.
products.decision: Improved macro candidate; not a claim of every-frame absence of clipping or flicker.

products.observations: Full rack, mounting frame, carriers and adjacent rack scale are visible. Connector action is intentionally small at this establishing angle.
Below-bridge angle exposes the manipulation region, socket bank, tool and hanging cable. Macro remains needed for latch detail.
Withdrawn housing is visibly separated from socket; jaws, blue boot and yellow latch tongue are readable. Actuator remains prominent in the foreground.
Oblique full-frame angle shows rail/carriage layout, depth offset and service carriers. Connector mechanics require companion close-ups.
